Contributor: qstep Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Hi. When a place closes, instead of deleting the point, we use the disused:*=* prefix, so in this case disused:amenity=cafe should be used. Do not simply delete anything, unless there is nothing in its place anymore. Other example is when a place closes and cannot be determinted what is was, so now it is an empty store: shop=vacant Thank you. Date: 2026-06-10T16:19:02+02:00
